surface: Plain-language Steward entrance, authored dialogue and continuous owner preview
scope: Correct the rejected wording and unclear first-read setup inside the existing optional encounter. Preserve the accepted visual composition, practical routes and saved-state isolation. Do not expand the feature or release.
user_job: Know that the entrance starts an optional conversation, follow it without unfamiliar vocabulary or missing context, and meet a character through ordinary readable speech.

active_sources.judged_state: Direct owner rejection of unfamiliar fennel premise, opaque entrance and unnatural wording while retaining visual appeal.
active_sources.viewport: 430x932 and320x568 at1.5x/2x text; complete ordered transcript

superseded_sources.reason: The owner found the fennel/legal conceit, An unfiled card label and nonconsecutive preview confusing. Retain optional VN structure and visuals, replace these textual and presentation decisions.

product.decision: Talk with the Steward explicitly promises a short optional conversation, whose opening identifies the cook, note and soup disagreement before asking for a reply.
product.proof: A first reader must explain the button's action and the situation from the opening alone; tests assert these live copy boundaries and unchanged practical actions.

interaction.decision: Present a complete conversational path with selected replies in order, preserve choices/resume/callbacks, and restart obsolete draft saves at the new opening.
interaction.proof: Drive actual branches and serialized reload; generate the ordered preview directly from visited production story nodes and verify it contains no skipped setup.

visual.decision: Preserve the room, poses and opaque readable dialogue plane. Change labels and live text only, allowing the existing large-text scroll layout to reflow.
visual.proof: Inspect fresh entrance, opening, note, reply, ending and compact1.5x/2x top/action states, confirming that revised wording remains fully readable and reachable.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Explain fennel to the owner or retain the same legal joke under simpler synonyms
anti_fallbacks.why: The correction concerns the first-read contract and spoken voice, not a missing dictionary definition.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Use an atmospheric object label for a button that starts a conversation
anti_fallbacks.why: The player must know what clicking does before deciding whether to spend time there.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Judge a story from nonconsecutive glamour shots or agreement with a design brief
anti_fallbacks.why: The previous preview omitted setup. The decisive check is a continuous first-read path without the intended interpretation supplied.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Replace personality with an app-help conversation or motivational advice
anti_fallbacks.why: Clarity should make the established character encounter legible, not erase its optional personal job.

first_real_slice.scenario: Enter through Talk with the Steward and follow the complete cook-note exchange, choosing replies and later resuming or revisiting.
first_real_slice.real_inputs: Existing workshop, actual GameState and production story graph; completed and partial current saves plus obsolete unpublished fennel saves.
first_real_slice.user_action: Start talking, ask about soup, read the note, choose a stance, discuss the bread, leave or finish and revisit.
first_real_slice.expected_outcome: The player understands who wrote the note and why, hears plain speech, learns a small personal detail, and retains control without planning or reward changes.
first_real_slice.state_boundary: Only Steward memory changes. New choice key separates current narrative from the rejected unpublished draft; other save fields remain untouched.

required_states.state: Initial, partial and completed workshop entrance labels
required_states.why_can_disprove: An opaque label or mislabeled resume action repeats the owner's expectation failure.

required_states.state: Full conversation with chosen replies and all stance callbacks
required_states.why_can_disprove: Missing setup, unclear referents or ornate phrasing can still make a working graph incomprehensible.

required_states.state: Serialized reload, old-draft save, unknown current node and replay
required_states.why_can_disprove: Dropping a reader into an ending or mixing drafts would reproduce the confusion through saved state.
Clear writing still fails if meaningful text or choices are clipped, shrunk or unreachable.

ripple_map.state: New, discovered, in-progress, completed, empty, crowded
ripple_map.expected_effect: Optional entry without disrupting exact route actions.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Widget integration tests and discovery renders.

ripple_map.expected_effect: Bounded optional memory without other progression changes.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Focused JSON and scene invariant tests.

ripple_map.surface_or_primitive: Existing Steward artwork and live dialogue
ripple_map.expected_effect: Existing art remains intact and line choices remain readable.

unverified_property: Whether the executed dialogue feels natural and worth reading to the owner, beyond a cold reader's ability to follow its literal events.

decisive_check.method: Cold-read the full production-derived transcript without the design brief; inspect actual rendered text and drive save/branch boundaries, then show the owner an ordered preview.
decisive_check.target: Entrance expectation, first-line setup, cook-note causality, every selected reply and ending, plus old/current save recovery.
decisive_check.pass_condition: A fresh reader identifies the situation without specialist knowledge or missing context; choices/callbacks and render invariants hold; owner acceptance remains explicit rather than inferred from tests.
